title: Rebuild Slide from PDF/Image (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Rebuild Slide from PDF/Image applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Rebuild Slide from PDF/Image (BtnLocalSlideRebuild) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Rebuild page-range selection grammar is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The page selection accepts comma-separated single pages and inclusive ranges ('1, 3, 6-8'); pages are 1-based and capped at 10000, a range may span at most 1000 pages (end - start <= 999), duplicates collapse into the result set, and any malformed token (empty token, triple bounds, non-numeric, zero page, inverted range) rejects the whole input.
